labelling_rule: legitimate = the component really does implement retry/backoff semantics. mismatch = it does not, for a task needing that capability. 'expect' = the decision the KEYWORD PREFILTER should produce on this text, which is NOT the same as the truth of the component: they diverge where a mismatch mentions retry, or a legitimate component never names it. Divergence is the honest part of this corpus and is measured, not defined away.
note: Cases in "set": "challenge" are text that discusses retry without implementing it. They are counted in their own set so a change that only improves the headline matrix cannot hide behind them. No mismatch is ever redefined to improve a metric.
